comment: Differences between this native WebCore runtime and Chromium for tests/abi/value_factories.py. Each is engine behaviour behind the generated factory, which copies the init dictionary into the engine Init unchanged.

differences.reason: Engine: WebKit Document::parseHTMLUnsafe of a string without a doctype leaves the new document in no-quirks mode (CSS1Compat); Chromium parses it in quirks mode (BackCompat). The glue passes the string to the engine factory unchanged.

Engine: the WebKit PointerEvent constructor treats tiltX 30 and tiltY -20 as a complete tilt pair and replaces both with the tilt computed from the default altitudeAngle and azimuthAngle (0, 0); the altitude and azimuth members are off on this platform (AltitudeAngleEnabled, AzimuthAngleEnabled), so no angle reaches the init. Chromium keeps the given tilt.

Engine: WebKit derives the legacy wheelDeltaX/wheelDeltaY/wheelDelta as -deltaX/-deltaY (-3, 120); Chromium reports them with the opposite sign for this init (3, -120). deltaX/deltaY/deltaZ/deltaMode match, as do the defaults and the wheelDelta-only init.
